item.title: The Healing Power of Heat: Dr. Schischenberger's Revolutionary Cancer Treatment
item.itunes:title: The Healing Power of Heat: Dr. Schischenberger's Revolutionary Cancer Treatment
item.description:
Join hosts Brian and Anna-Maria Clement in this enlightening episode of "Health, Happiness, and Healing" as they welcome the pioneering Dr. Schischenberger. Discover the remarkable story of a man whose lifelong passion for medicine and engineering led to groundbreaking advancements in cancer treatment. Listen as Dr. Schischenberger shares his journey, which began with a childhood dream and blossomed into a pioneering career in surgery and innovative treatments for cancer, including the revolutionary use of high-temperature therapy.

Learn about the development of the Verthermia therapy, a cutting-edge treatment offering hope to those battling advanced-stage cancers. With heartwarming patient success stories and insights into this innovative approach, this episode is a testament to the power of persistence, creativity, and empathy in the medical field. Find out from Dr. Schischenberger how controlled hyperthermia is breaking boundaries in cancer treatment, offering new lifelines to affected patients.

Explore the promising potential of thermotherapy beyond cancer, as it shows efficacy against viruses and other diseases. Engage with conversations that highlight the courage of healthcare innovators and the importance of alternative treatment paths for chronic diseases. Don't miss this inspiring dialogue full of hope and healing possibilities.

item.title: GMO Alarm: Jeffrey Smith on CRISPR, Roundup, and Your Health
item.itunes:title: GMO Alarm: Jeffrey Smith on CRISPR, Roundup, and Your Health
item.description:
It's time for Health, Happiness, and Healing with Hippocrates on Legends 100.3, hosted by Anna Maria and Brian Clement. In this episode, Jeffrey Smith explains the health and environmental risks of GMOs, glyphosate (Roundup), and new gene‑editing tools like CRISPR.

Smith summarizes epidemiological data, animal studies, clinical reports, and mechanisms linking GMOs and glyphosate to chronic conditions and microbiome disruption, and warns about the dangers of unregulated genetically modified microorganisms.

Practical takeaways: prioritize organic and Non‑GMO products, avoid crops commonly sprayed with glyphosate, and visit responsibletechnology.org for resources. For Hippocrates Health Institute programs and tours, call 561-471-8876 or visit HippocratesHealthInstitute.org.

item.title: Turning the Tide on Brain Cancer: A 30-Year Quest for a Breakthrough
item.itunes:title: Turning the Tide on Brain Cancer: A 30-Year Quest for a Breakthrough
item.description:
Hosts Anna Maria and Brian Clement speak with Dr. Deary about his 30-year research into the tumor suppressor p53 and the development of an FDA‑approved drug that boosts the innate immune system to target brain tumors with specific mutations.

The episode covers clinical trial results, combining the drug with tumor‑treating fields, the role of precision oncology and the Wynn Consortium in tailoring therapies, and ongoing efforts to expand treatment options for hard-to-treat cancers.

Dr. Deary also explains how patients and physicians can connect for consultations and support, and emphasizes continued research and hope for better outcomes.

item.title: Swiss Physician’s Breakthrough: How PlaqueX Reversed a Mother’s Heart Disease
item.itunes:title: Swiss Physician’s Breakthrough: How PlaqueX Reversed a Mother’s Heart Disease
item.description:
Hosts Anna Maria and Brian Clement speak with Dr. Anita Baxes about her Swiss upbringing, medical training, and the development of PlaqueX (a phosphatidylcholine-based therapy) that helped reverse her mother’s cardiovascular disease without invasive surgery.

The episode explains how PlaqueX supports cell membrane repair, improves blood flow, and may benefit heart, brain, liver, and kidney health, while touching on its potential role in longevity and cognitive wellness.

Dr. Baxes also shares challenges she faced with regulatory and pharmaceutical opposition, how the treatment has been used clinically in Europe and the U.S., and practical takeaways for anyone interested in non‑invasive approaches to chronic disease.

item.title: Fighting Advanced Stage Cancer with Groundbreaking Hyperthermia Treatment
item.itunes:title: Fighting Advanced Stage Cancer with Groundbreaking Hyperthermia Treatment
item.description:
This enlightening episode, explores the breakthrough technique of heating the blood to combat advanced stage four cancers.

Discover the origin story of this cutting-edge therapy that began as an antiviral protocol during the AIDS crisis and later evolved into a powerful cancer weapon. Listen as Dr. Swishenberger shares how, with FDA support, Vertmira adapted the process for treating cancer, yielding incredibly high survival rates among palliative cancer patients previously given minimal chances of survival.

Dive into the captivating science behind Vertmira's procedure, which targets an ideal temperature range to disrupt or eliminate cancer cells while regular cells remain unperturbed. Learn about the function of heat shock proteins in humans, their evolutionary significance, and how they play a crucial role in this groundbreaking treatment.

Dr. Swishenberger, a cardiothoracic surgeon, lends his deep knowledge towards understanding lung cancer treatment via hyperthermia. Understand how genetics, exposure to carcinogens such as smoke and environmental toxins increase susceptibility to specific cancer types, including lung, colon, pancreas, and breast, even in non-smokers.

Wrap up the episode learning about Vertmira’s impressive strides in making this powerful alternative cancer treatment widely available. Realize that wellness begins with informed choice and understanding alternative treatment options essential in navigating the path to health and healing. Listen to this riveting episode to keep abreast with the revolutionary developments in the relentless battle against cancer.

item.title: A Conversation With Stacey Malkin
item.itunes:title: A Conversation With Stacey Malkin
item.description:
Hosts Anna Maria and Brian Clement welcome Stacey Malkin, the co-founder and managing editor of the U.S. Rights to Know. This non-profit public health research group sheds light on corporate malpractices, especially in the beauty industry, by revealing harmful components in popular products that consumers are usually unaware of.

Malkin unveils the shocking reality of toxic substances like formaldehyde in baby shampoos and other beauty products. She discusses the pharmaceutical giants' stubbornness to reformulate their products, despite years of persistent pressure from advocacy groups. This episode is a powerful symbol of the influence exerted by committed non-profit organizations and informed consumers in promoting change in large companies.

Further, the conversation explores the theme of deceptive marketing strategies employed by corporations, including the promotion of junk food to children. The show offers hope alongside this harsh reality, citing examples from countries that successfully controlled junk food advertising and witnessed a significant decrease in disease rates as a result.

Stacey also touches upon her latest research in ultra-processed foods, discussing their addictive nature that promotes overeating and their detrimental health effects, including increasing the risks of cancer and mental health issues.

Listen in as Stacey reveals the threats of new food technology like gene editing, or CRISPR, and how it's being used for ultra-industrializing the food chain. Learn about failed enterprises like the billion-dollar Silicon Valley burger and understand why simply replacing meat isn't the sustainable solution it's made out to be.

This enlightening conversation urges listeners to scrutinize their consumption habits and inspires them to join the fight against corporate manipulation in the beauty and food industry. Tune in to get motivated to make a difference.

item.description:

Her story impressively debunks the common misconceptions about the clash between veganism and athletic performance—showcasing how a plant-based lifestyle can fuel intense physical activity, enhance mental resilience, contribute to overall wellness, and redefine the preconceived dietary norms in professional sports.

item.title: Confronting the Pharmaceutical Industry with Dr. John Abramson
item.itunes:title: Confronting the Pharmaceutical Industry with Dr. John Abramson
item.description:
Our guest, Dr. John Abramson, a highly-regarded family practitioner and former Harvard Medical School educator, uncovers the alarming facts concealed behind the benign facade of the medical industry.

Discover the pervasive commercialization and manipulation of information that now pervades medical research and academia. Dr. Abramson lays bare the startling greed-driven narrative and shines a light on the unnerving realities, including the heavy influence of the pharmaceutical industry on medical publications and the dubious authenticity of even peer-reviewed articles.

Furthermore, we dive into the implications of the pharmaceutical industry's stronghold over the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), the controversial 'FDA approved' label, and its impacts on healthcare quality. Dr. Abramson unmasks the tragic consequences of industry dominance as well, with a staggering 1.1 million Americans in excess of death rates in other affluent countries in 2021 due to medical manipulations.

We also examine the growing disillusionment among medical students and the alarming trend of doctors abandoning their practices – a looming healthcare crisis rooted in the prioritization of profits over patient care.

This episode delivers a strong message about the necessity for an enlightened understanding of the commercial interests shaping our current medical practice. With a focus on empowering patients and educating physicians, Dr. Abramson signifies why it's essential to break free from commercial influences on health and wellbeing. Join us, as we work towards a more transparent, compassionate, and effective healthcare system for all.

item.title: An Unwavering Journey Towards Natural Healing with Sylvie Beljanski
item.itunes:title: An Unwavering Journey Towards Natural Healing with Sylvie Beljanski
item.description:
We welcome Sylvie Beljanski, an inspiring personality determined to propagate her father's ground-breaking research on plant-based medicinal treatments. From a career in law to venturing into the domain of alternative medicine, Sylvie demonstrated immense resolve, turning a life of adversity into a compelling journey of healing and discovery.

Her story revolves around the challenges she faced during her search for efficient, non-toxic methods to enhance public health. Despite the multitude of challenges she faced, Sylvie remained steadfast in carrying out her father's research, which centered on the use of simple plant-based medicines to bolster the immune system and combat diseases like cancer.

In this episode, delve into the riveting world of legal battles, breakthrough research, and Sylvia's valiant contribution to the realm of health science. Learn about the transformative work of the Beljanski Foundation in cancer research and the lasting legacy of plant-based solutions in the world of healing.

Immerse yourself in this thought-provoking conversation titled "Health, Happiness, and Healing with Hippocrates". Discover the understated truths about the history of medicine and its deep-seated roots in nature, and why the shift towards laboratory-synthesized drugs has brought about an array of health complications.

This episode is a must-listen for everyone keen on natural healing, resilience and wellness. Tune in to this fascinating discussion and uncover the potential to transform lives with non-conventional, plant-based treatments.

item.title: Michael's Inspiring Journey of Resilience
item.itunes:title: Michael's Inspiring Journey of Resilience
item.description:
Coming from a turbulent past dominated by addiction, Michael's story of determination, resilience, and enduring commitment to overcome cancer and substance abuse is nothing short of extraordinary.

Michael opens up about his harrowing journey battling esophageal cancer. Despite the aggressive growth of his tumor and the detrimental effects of invasive treatments, he held his ground and sought an alternative treatment. His life took a dramatic turn upon being introduced to a non-invasive cancer treatment, Vithermia, which astonishingly cleared his PET scan and eliminated the tumor.

The episode further unfolds as Michael courageously battles not only cancer but also his past addiction. His approach to sobriety provides him with the necessary tools and resilience to combat his cancer. With a renewed lease of life, Michael channels his experiences into serving society, emphasizing mindfulness and gratitude as cornerstones of his day-to-day existence.

The story shifts gears as it introduces listeners to the holistic healing approach of the Hippocrates Health Institute in West Palm Beach. Championing alternative paths towards health and happiness, it invites those searching for wellness to embark on a transformative journey akin to Michael’s.

This episode holds a gripping narrative spotlighting Michaels's triumphant story of resilience against all odds: addiction and cancer. Despite a meager 1% chance of recovery and a looming cancer prognosis, he defied the statistics with his indomitable spirit and emerged victorious. His story serves as a beacon of hope, inspiring listeners to never give up, no matter the challenges they face.

This episode not only offers inspiration and hope, it also questions the conventional acceptance of medical treatments and highlights the transformative power of positive thinking, faith, and holistic health. Michael's journey impeccably underscores the truth behind the adage, "Where there’s a will, there’s a way."

Episode at a glance: An exemplary story of courage, resilience, and the astounding human capacity to triumph over adversity. Accentuating the importance of self-belief, coping strategies, and divine guidance, this episode serves as a guiding light for all those navigating their own struggles.

Hear a heartwarming tale that highlights the power of destiny — surrendering to it while continuously aiming for happiness, completeness, and wholeness along the way.

item.title: A Journey Towards Sustainable Living with Will and Madeline Tuttle
item.itunes:title: A Journey Towards Sustainable Living with Will and Madeline Tuttle
item.description:
In the most recent episode of Health, Happiness, and Healing with Hippocrates, we have an enlightening conversation with renowned health advocates, Will and Madeline Tuttle. This power couple has dedicated their lives towards advocating healing via nutritive, purely plant-based diets. They emphasize the role of personal responsibility in our dietary choices, relationships, the information we consume, and the consciousness we sustain.

Will and Madeline bravely address how most people unknowingly contribute to animal suffering through their nutrition choices. They discuss the resulting negative consequences on their health and the environment. Will embraces this concept even further in his forthcoming book, which challenges the traditional perspective that our bodies require animal-based nutrition, calling for an end to harmful generational eating habits.

On a similar note, Madeline divulges her passion for a raw food diet, sharing the vast health benefits eating fresh and organic. She also delves into the spiritual spectrum, highlighting the significance of spiritual alignment with the universe and trusting our innate instincts. This enlightening discussion encourages listeners to adopt sustainable and ethical eating habits and guides them towards personal growth.

Our guests embark on a historical exploration of the Essenes, a wholly plant-based civilization. They highlight how this group manifested the power of live foods. Following this inspiring tale, the conversation navigates to an urgent appeal for environmental protection, emphasizing the importance of personal responsibility in contributing positive vibrations to our planet.

We then take a poignant look at the empowering documentary "Wellness, A Journey to Transformation", exemplifying the core message of our podcast - personal responsibility in healing. Throughout the episode, our guests share personal tales, valuable insights, and provide guidance to our listeners about creating a balanced, healthy life.

The episode concludes with a motivational call to action for our listeners, urging them to trust themselves and take the first step towards attaining unparalleled wellness and healing. Embark on this enlightening journey and discover the keys to health, sustainable living, and global preservation.

item.description:
We welcome celebrated figures in progressive healthcare, Dr. Will Tuttle and Madeline Tuttle. 

Dr. Tuttle enlights us with his insights into how fear and awareness presently divides humanity. He discusses the divisive trajectory in race relations and healthcare that fuels existing fears. Yet, he believes that people are starting to recognize their innate spiritual potential, rekindling hope for a life filled with radiant health, joy, and emancipation.

Madeline Tuttle draws upon her artistic background to highlight the woman's perspective. Sighting the prevalence of male dominance, she underscores the gentle yet powerful influence of the feminine in spreading love and joy. She advocates raising boys who respect women, embedding the principle that love always triumphs.

The conversation takes a thought-provoking turn towards globalism, seen as a potent movement spearheaded by fewer than 5% of the world's super-wealthy population. It spotlights how this immense wealth has far-reaching control over governmental policies, corporate actions, banking industries, and even media narratives which shape our perception of the world.

Progressing further, our distinguished guests weave a holistic panorama of purposeful living defined by inner harmony, acknowledging that internal turmoil emerges from our fears. This unique integration of consciousness and healing promotes a deeper understanding of ourselves and our surroundings. It paints an inspiring vision for humanity's future, where we rise above fear, establish a profound connection with our self, and commit to balanced, conscious living.

As we journey through these comprehensive discussions, the connection between animal exploitation and multiple human diseases emerges. The discourse underscores the adverse health consequences of our actions towards nature, positioning these as preventable results of our war against nature. It fosters mindfulness towards media manipulation and the urgency of distinguishing fact from fiction for the sake of our health.

To cap this enlightening episode, Madeline shares her heartfelt interaction with a cow, evoking a sense of empathy and respect for all life forms. She offers an intriguing perspective on the freshness (or the lack thereof) of meat. Anticipate more revelations from the Tuttles in our upcoming episode! Enjoy this stimulating dialogue and join us at Health, Happiness, and Healing to nurture a healthier, happier, and healing lifestyle.

item.title: From Healing to Peak Performance with Dr. Ed Bice
item.itunes:title: From Healing to Peak Performance with Dr. Ed Bice
item.description:
Dr. Ed Bice, a former chiropractor now specializing in mind-body wellness and peak performance is featured on this weeks podcast.

Dr. Bice talks about his transition from the world of chiropractics to helping individuals tap into the amazing capacities of their minds to achieve higher performance. Listen to fascinating stories about miracles facilitated by immense determination and positive thinking, illustrating what we can accomplish with the right mindset.

He challenges listeners to confront their mindset regarding their life and success, emphasizing the importance of taking personal responsibility rather than resorting to blame. This thought-provoking conversation offers valuable insights on Emotional Freedom Techniques (EFT tapping), self-love, and breaking free from negative thought patterns.

The episode underscores the idea that while pain is universal, suffering is optional. With a focus on the essentiality of a supportive community, Dr. Bice advises listeners to remain steadfast in their journey of self-growth, even in the face of resistance. The discussion ends with tools to foster a mindset for happiness and success, a commitment to self-love, and strategies for transforming everyday realities.
